title: $1,000 in the Nasdaq 100 in 1999 is now worth this
caption:
In 1999, the Nasdaq 100 was tech stocks, just before the crash.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:QQQ:1999-03-10} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with the Nasdaq 100 in 1999? 👇
sources: the Nasdaq 100 price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time
